release_notes:
Fix DB password drift on install.sh re-run

Secrets (DB_PASS, DB_ROOT_PASS, GAUTH_ENC_KEY, GSMTOOL_KEY_SALT) were
regenerated with fresh random values on every run, including re-runs of an
already-installed site. CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS silently no-ops when the
MariaDB user already exists, so the DB user's real password stayed from the
first run while the VirtualHost got a new DB_PASS each re-run — the app then
can't connect ("DB Connection Failed!") despite the installer reporting
success, since its own verification step only checks the public DNS-resolved
site, not the local vhost (so it can't see this failure either when DNS
isn't pointed at the server yet).

Now: reuse existing secrets from the current VirtualHost if present, and
always sync the actual MariaDB password via ALTER USER so any already-drifted
install self-heals on next run too.
